frames.title: THE FALLEN WARDEN
frames.text:
The Warden hath fallen.

By thy hand, this forsaken hall is freed from the shadow that bound it.

frames.title: THE LAST STONE
frames.text:
Yet rejoice not too soon, O Knight.

Thou hast broken but one chain. Beyond these walls, the corruption yet endureth.

frames.title: THE CALL HOME
frames.text:
Return now unto thy world and gather thy strength.

When the gate is opened once more... the realm shall call for thee again.
